definitions.gloss: prompt decision; snap judgment; deciding on the spot
definitions.explanation: Making a decision immediately without deliberation. Can be positive (decisive) or negative (hasty) depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即決|そっけつ}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: The company president is the type who makes quick decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{即決|そっけつ}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}られて→取る：00565_toru⟧しまう。
examples.english: This property is popular, so if you don't decide right away, someone else will take it.

notes:
{即決|そっけつ} means making a decision immediately, on the spot. Composed of {即|そく} (immediately) + {決|けつ} (decide).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即決|そっけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to decide immediately
- {即決|そっけつ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: buy-it-now price (on auction sites)
- {即決|そっけつ}⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧: summary trial (legal)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{即決|そっけつ}: decide on the spot

USAGE:
- Real estate: pressure to decide quickly on popular properties
- Online auctions: a fixed price for immediate purchase
- Business: a decisive leader who doesn't hesitate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{即断|そくだん}→即断：18317_sokudan⟧: snap judgment (nearly synonymous)
- ⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧: decision, resolution (not necessarily quick)
- ⟦{迷|まよ}わ→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ず⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide without hesitation
